parsed.rationale: Four separate packages — Playlist, Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit — each declare an extension on URLSession in unrelated files (PlaylistFetcher.swift, URLSession+WebSession.swift, URLSessionProtocol.swift, RequestService.swift). None of the records carry any restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so there is no intentional-duplication signal. The Core package already hosts a dedicated URLSession extension file (URLSession+WebSession.swift), making it the natural canonical home. Consolidating all URLSession extension members into Core eliminates the name-collision risk and gives the three consumer packages (Playlist, Playback, MusicShareKit) a single, auditable surface to depend on.
